stage_note: Challenge: numbers must not change, so presentation logic is split into pure reportPresentation.ts (table/KPI/bars built from the same API payload; cover totals = sum stock / sum weekly sell-out, matching the API overall value) and tested for parity. Saved-report pinned state and recent runs are shown only from what the API returns (dashboards widgets saved_report_id; reports inbox deliveries with saved_report_id); nothing invented. Periods remain text inputs (quarter codes) because the API takes free period codes; only id inputs become pickers.
